newsitem.title: CHINA: ATT's NCR unit plans China ventures- Xinhua.
newsitem.headline: ATT's NCR unit plans China ventures- Xinhua.

text.p: AT&T Corp's NCR unit is planning to set up two joint ventures in China early next year, both of them related to automated teller machines (ATMs), the official Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
One of the ventures would produce ATMs while the other would specialise in repairs for the equipment as well as NCR computer systems, Xinhua said.
It gave no details of the scale of the two ventures.
NCR was negotiating with research institutes under the Ministry of Electronics Industry, it quoted company officials as saying, but added they declined to give details.

China has been trying to expand the use of ATMs as part of its drive to computerise the banking system and reduce the dependency on cash. It has also linked the use of ATMs to plans for the expanded use of credit cards.

Major Chinese customers of NCR included the People's Bank of China -- the central bank -- along with the Construction Bank of China, the Agricultural Bank of China, the Bank of Communications and Xinhua itself, the news agency said.
